entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker who helps defend Eiganjo and resolves to search the Multiverse for Tamiyo and the emperor.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A planeswalker and the Emperor of Kamigawa, whose spark destabilizes and takes her from Kamigawa again after she names Light-Paws her proxy.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A moonfolk planeswalker who bears the Reality Chip and is dragged through a portal by Tezzeret.

entities.name: Phyrexian Tamiyo
entities.description: Tamiyo after being Phyrexianized in the laboratory, now loyal to Phyrexia as her new family; the first Phyrexianized planeswalker.

entities.name: Tezzeret
aliases: the man with the metal arm
entities.description: A planeswalker with a metal arm and power over technology who works for Phyrexia, seizes the Reality Chip's hold and escapes with Tamiyo.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian monster who survives his wound and Phyrexianizes Tamiyo.

entities.name: Risona
entities.description: The leader of the Asari Uprisers, who storms Eiganjo to abolish the empire and is knocked out by Kaito's thrown rock.

entities.name: Light-Paws
entities.description: A kitsune advisor who is named the emperor's proxy and becomes the Regent of Kamigawa, growing a new tail.

entities.name: Eiko Shizuki
entities.description: Kaito's sister, who defends Eiganjo and becomes a senior advisor.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: The guardian kami of Kamigawa, bonded to the emperor, who gives her blessing to Light-Paws as proxy.

entities.name: Himoto
entities.description: The kami in drone form who leads Eiko to Kaito's aid with a dagger.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: Tamiyo's son, who promises to help look for her.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian leader, informed of Jin-Gitaxias's success.

entities.name: Asari Uprisers
entities.description: Rebels who storm Eiganjo under Risona.

entities.name: Imperials
entities.description: The court and samurai defending Eiganjo.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The outside power Tezzeret serves, seeking planeswalkers.

entities.name: Reality Chip
entities.description: A chip that augments the wearer's powers; it passes from the emperor to Tamiyo, and Tezzeret seizes control of it.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: The means by which Tezzeret travels between planes, which takes a toll on him.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: The Imperial city attacked by the Uprisers.

entities.name: Otawara
entities.description: The floating city with Tameshi's compound.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane under attack.

events.summary: The Wanderer, Kaito and Tamiyo defeat the henchmen in the compound and hold Tezzeret paralyzed; the Wanderer decides to bring him to Kyodai.
events.quote: "Yes. We will decide his fate together."

events.summary: Tezzeret takes control of the Reality Chip on the Wanderer's hand, destabilizing her spark and linking her to Kyodai in agony.
events.quote: no time to shout a warning before Tezzeret took control of the Reality Chip.

events.summary: Kyodai warns the Wanderer through the bond that Risona has brought an army to Eiganjo.
Kaito knocks Tezzeret out with two crates.
events.quote: The impact knocked Tezzeret out cold.

events.summary: Tamiyo removes the chip from the Wanderer's hand and then places it on her own hand to pilot a surveillance mech to Eiganjo.
events.quote: Tamiyo lifted the Reality Chip to the back of her own hand and pressed the panel to her flesh.

events.summary: The Wanderer disables a surveillance mech and the group flies to Eiganjo on its back, carrying Tezzeret.
events.quote: The mech let out a ragged groan before lowering its body to the ground

events.summary: The Uprisers have breached Eiganjo's gates as the mech arrives.
events.quote: Risona and the Asari Uprisers had indeed come to Eiganjo—and they'd already breached the gates.

events.summary: Tezzeret wakes and flings Kaito's smoke devices, then jumps from the mech; Tamiyo loses control and the group jumps before the mech crashes.
events.quote: the mech exploding against the side of an Imperial apartment.

events.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo track Tezzeret as he heads for the emperor and fight him on the rooftops, with Eiko's dagger striking him.
events.quote: In his thigh was a gleaming dagger, the gold handle carved with the symbol of the Imperials.

events.summary: Tezzeret takes control of the chip on Tamiyo's hand, opens a portal and drags her away.
events.quote: Tezzeret yanked Tamiyo through the snapping light, and they both vanished from the rooftop.

events.summary: The Wanderer fights Risona in Kyodai's temple and offers her surrender.
events.quote: "Drop your blade. There is no need for you to die this way."

events.summary: Kaito knocks Risona unconscious with a thrown rock and she is bound, ending the battle.
events.quote: something flew across the room and cracked against the side of her skull, knocking her unconscious.

events.summary: With her spark destabilizing, the emperor names Light-Paws her proxy to rule Kamigawa with Kyodai's blessing.
events.quote: "You will be my proxy, and rule Kamigawa for as long as I am unable."

events.summary: The emperor's spark takes hold and she vanishes from Kamigawa again.
events.quote: The spark took hold of her, and the emperor once again vanished from Kamigawa.

events.summary: Light-Paws grows a new tail and Kaito and Eiko bow to the new Regent of Kamigawa.
events.quote: Kaito and his sister bowed to the new Regent of Kamigawa.

events.summary: Kaito says goodbye to Eiko, promising someday to try to reconcile with Light-Paws, and leaves to master planeswalking and find Tamiyo and the emperor.
events.quote: He would search the Multiverse for Tamiyo.

events.summary: In the Phyrexian laboratory Tamiyo awakens Phyrexianized, loyal to Phyrexia and calling it her new family.
Jin-Gitaxias announces the first Phyrexianized planeswalker and Tezzeret asks whether Elesh Norn knows.
events.quote: Does Elesh Norn know you've succeeded in creating the first Phyrexianized planeswalker?"

relations.quote: "You will be my proxy, and rule Kamigawa for as long as I am unable."
Kaito and his sister bowed to the new Regent of Kamigawa.
She raised her sword to the Wanderer's.

relations.note: storms the palace and fights the emperor
relations.quote: "You stormed the palace and murdered dozens."
Does Elesh Norn know you've succeeded in creating the first Phyrexianized planeswalker?"

relations.note: he says he has what Phyrexia wants

relations.quote: The bond between the great kami and the emperor had always been strong.
Nashi had promised, as soon as he was old enough, he'd help look for Tamiyo, too.
